plugins.name: code-modernization
plugins.description: Guided modernization for any legacy codebase: assessment, an interactive map, business-rule mining, an approved plan, then an uplift, rewrite or rebuild with independent proof that the new code behaves like the old. ZCode port of Anthropic's code-modernization plugin (Apache 2.0).

description_i18n.zh-CN: 面向任意遗留代码库的引导式现代化：评估、交互式拓扑图、业务规则挖掘、需人工批准的方案，随后进行同栈升级、跨栈重写或架构重建，并以独立证据证明新旧行为一致。移植自 Anthropic 的 code-modernization 插件（Apache 2.0）。
